ItemID: 1; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Disposable gloves would be useful for messy workshop tasks alongside my resin and adhesive supplies; I would check material compatibility first.
ItemID: 2; Title: Kraken Bond RTV Silicone White Caulk - Door and Window Sealer, Water Resistant%100 Universal Silicone Sealant for Kitchen & Bathroom, Anti Shrink Flexible Filler | 1 Pack, 10.1 Oz. Cartridge; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases center on fastening and fabrication, and I do not currently have a specific sealing job in mind.
ItemID: 3; Title: JOAPRIL Deck Joist Tape 4" x 50', Butyl Joist Tape for decking, Waterproof and Anti-Corrosion Deck Joist Flashing Tape for Top of Joists, Rim Joists, Under Joists and Beams-1 Rolls; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in adhesive tapes does not imply a decking project, so this feels too specialized right now.
ItemID: 4; Title: LIONMAX #8 x 1-5/8" Exterior Wood Screws, 800 PCS Star Drive Deck Screws, Tan Coated for Outdoor Use, Coarse Threads, No Stripping, Anti-Rust, T-25 Drive Bit Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use screw assortments, but 800 exterior screws in one size would need a specific outdoor project to justify.
ItemID: 5; Title: 1290 PCS 24 Size Rubber O Ring Assortment Kit, O Ring Set with Pick & Hook Kit, Universal Rubber Pressure Washer O Ring Kit for Hose, Faucet, Automotive, Air and Gas Sealing Repair; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A range of replacement seals fits my habit of keeping assorted repair parts ready for different jobs.
ItemID: 6; Title: FOLIV 265PCS Black Self Tapping Screws, 8 x 1/2” to 1-1/2” (410) Stainless Steel Modified Truss Head Sheet Metal Screws Assortment Kit, Black Oxide Self Drilling, 6 Different Length Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Multiple lengths and sheet metal fastening closely match my recent drill bits, rivets, and hardware purchases.
ItemID: 7; Title: Realth Magnetic Cylinder Dia. 1/4" x 1" Length Neodymium Permanent Rare Earth Circular Magnets Rod 12 Pack (MC608); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could serve a fabrication project, but I have no immediate use for this particular magnet shape and size.
ItemID: 8; Title: 4-40 and 6-32 Machine Screws, Nuts and Washer 280 pcs Pan Head Screws #4-40#6-32 - Screws Nuts and Washers Set - Full Thread Small Screws with Storage Box; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Small imperial fasteners complement my metric bolt kits and fit my recurring interest in organized hardware assortments.
ItemID: 9; Title: Fidioto 1900pcs Wire Ferrules Terminals Kit, AWG 22-10 Terminal Connector Wire Insulated Cord Pin Ends Terminals for Electric, Industrial, Power Control System, etc.; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent history gives me stronger reasons to stock mechanical fasteners than a large supply of electrical terminals.
ItemID: 10; Title: MUKSIRON 1.56 Inch Stainless Steel Chain Quick Links - 12 Pack 5/32" Stainless Locking Carabiner Connector Threaded Oval Ring for Pet Traction,Lamp Hook,Camping, Fishing - 800 Lbs Capacity; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am interested in practical hardware, but I would pass until I need threaded links for a particular attachment job.
